basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent graduate from a business school, currently diving into the world of accounting and finance. I have a keen interest in cryptocurrencies, particularly emerging tokens, which I explore in my spare time. I'm based in London and usually online in the evenings after work. I'm working as a junior accountant and am single, focusing on my career and personal growth. In my free time, I enjoy collecting anime figures and exploring new Reddit communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Accounting and Finance from a UK university. My knowledge in accounting is mostly academic, with practical insights gained from my current job and self-study. I've recently started exploring cryptocurrency markets through online resources and forums.
